capabilities: select the current line from start to end with ESC
rebind the selection hotkey to another key combination
trigger line selection on mobile via commands
extras: README is very short; the plugin is described as simple and offers one behavior with a configurable hotkey.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in single-key command to select the whole line the cursor is on.
summary: Selection helper that selects the entire current line when you press ESC, with a rebindable hotkey and mobile command support.
